ns2:course.label: Research Experiences in Health and Kinesiology
ns2:course.description: Supervised laboratory experiences in health and kinesiology research; individual work under the supervision of members of the faculty in their respective fields. The student assists with data collection, processing, and analysis for research in progress. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
